verdict.rationale: The CLI docs mention an option to 'Auto-approve all actions (use with caution)', which implies a default confirmation mode and an all-or-nothing bypass. Esc lets a human pause the running agent. That is a binary toggle, not tiered autonomy levels. missing for 10: graduated or tiered autonomy levels, per-action or per-tool approval policies, team- or lead-level policy configuration, in-depth docs on confirmation modes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
